subject_id: Population genetics (the mediating wrapper that IS the operational S)
notes: ESTIMATE: Contribution shares for the three founders of mathematical population genetics. No authoritative quantitative source; derived from historiographic prominence (Fisher 1918+1930 as foundational mathematical synthesis; Haldane 1924-32 for selection-coefficient models; Wright 1931-32 for drift/adaptive landscape). These are rough proxies only — the three architects are routinely listed as roughly co-equal by historians (Provine 1971). Certainty capped at 0.3 per estimate rubric. Basis: Wikipedia population genetics article lists all three as co-founders; no fraction source exists.

subject_id: The Modern Synthesis (neo-Darwinian synthesis / synthetic theory of evolution / 'evolutionary synthesis')
notes: ESTIMATE: Theory-DNA basis for the gap-f predicate. Population genetics is the real proximate parent (mediating S); Darwin and Mendel are deep roots. No authoritative historiographic source quantifies this split. Estimate derives from specimen's own discrepancy #1 analysis, which concludes the literal Darwin-Mendel dyad as proximate parents is only ~0.55 confidence while population genetics as the true seam is ~0.9. Certainty 0.25 — this is an interpretive estimate of a multi-author historical process, not a measured quantity. Basis: specimen discrepancy #1 + Wikipedia modern synthesis article structure.
